exact_changes: Omit tuae mirabile after Ecclesiae. The old your/wondrous modifiers are not translated as though retained.

The named referent is already supplied in the same complete old prayer; it is relocated and shortened, not independently newly composed theology.
The1862 text already has et lumen and tranquillius. Those words do not require synthesis from Gelasian apparatus variants.
Use the separately witnessed complete Qui vivit et regnat in saecula saeculorum. conclusion and marked R.Amen, with their old sources declared separately.
